messages.subject: RE: Project Indigo — Subscription Agreement (our counter)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver — our counter attached (tracked over your mark-up). We can't live with £250k on borrowings — the company has ordinary-course equipment finance — so we've moved it to £350k, which we think is fair. We've accepted the 1% / 15-business-day information rights and the 18-month warranty limit. We've nudged the de-minimis basket up to £150k to match. If £350k and £150k work, I think we're substantively there.

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Corporate & Financing
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 1100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
